source: 搜神记 第一卷 第一章 神农使者
title: Farewell and descent
purpose: Extend the first scene after mission transfer: Tuobaye accepts responsibility, secures the relics, and leaves Nanji Mountain toward the wider journey.
video_policy: Generate storyboard frames with locked character/location references first. Gemini experimental I2V should use a single approved storyboard image as source of truth.

shots.title: Relics secured after the mandate
shots.location: 南际山顶草地，夕阳转入暮色
shots.storyboard_prompt: Cinematic realistic ancient Chinese mythic fantasy storyboard frame, 16:9. Adult Tuobaye age 28 to 32 kneels in a safe open Nanji Mountain meadow at late golden sunset, carefully wrapping ancient relics and three worn sheepskin books into a cloth bundle at his waist, green bamboo flute still visible. White-haired Shennong in deep purple herbal robe sits nearby with calm wise farewell expression, not dead, not injured, simply solemn and peaceful. Distant sea glow, waterfall mist far behind, poplar trees, drifting white catkins, jade-green begonia in grass. Natural fabric textures, restrained drama lighting, no text, no watermark.
shots.video_prompt: Animate this storyboard frame as a serene 8-10 second cinematic short-drama shot. Tuobaye carefully secures the relic bundle and bamboo flute while Shennong watches calmly. Preserve safe Nanji Mountain meadow, golden dusk, distant sea glow, waterfall mist, purple robe, rugged cloth, and solemn farewell mood. Gentle wind only, no danger, no violence, no injury, no minors, no text.

shots.title: Last look back from the meadow path
shots.storyboard_prompt: Cinematic realistic ancient Chinese mythic fantasy storyboard frame, 16:9. Adult Tuobaye stands at the beginning of a safe grassy mountain path, turning back for one last respectful look toward Shennong seated in the meadow behind him. Tuobaye has rugged rough cloth clothing, green bamboo flute, cloth bundle with relics. Shennong is an elderly white-haired sage in deep purple robe, calm and luminous in the distance, farewell not death. Moon-blue dusk begins mixing with warm sunset, waterfall mist far away, poplar silhouettes, white catkins drifting. Safe open terrain, no cliff edge, no falling, no text, no watermark.
shots.video_prompt: Animate this storyboard frame as a quiet farewell shot. Tuobaye turns back briefly from the safe mountain path, then steadies himself to leave. Shennong remains seated calmly in the meadow behind him. Preserve identities, clothing, bamboo flute, relic bundle, dusk meadow, waterfall mist, and no danger. Gentle wind and slow camera drift only, no text.

shots.title: Departure into the mountain night
shots.location: 南际山山路，暮色安全行进
shots.storyboard_prompt: Cinematic realistic ancient Chinese mythic fantasy storyboard frame, 16:9. Adult Tuobaye walks alone along a safe descending mountain path at blue-gold dusk, carrying a cloth bundle of ancient books and token, green bamboo flute at his waist, rugged rough cloth clothing, determined but grieving expression. Nanji Mountain wilderness continues: grass, poplar shadows, distant waterfall mist and sea glow behind him, first stars above. No cliff edge, no falling, no attack, no injury.
